answer_1.quote: In this work, we investigate these questions through experiments on social media text and synthetically noised corpora... We evaluate on a broad spectrum of error types... and measure translation quality using metrics such as COMET.
answer_1.outputs: Translated sentences from source to target language

answer_2.quote: Our base corpus-level translation metric is COMET... We also report BLEU and chrF results... We use faux-BLEU, faux-COMET, and ΔQE based on COMETKiwi as reference‑free metrics.
